text:
Samira (Partnerships): Heads-up: FluxCompute is changing their marketplace feed next week: currency will be JPY per-file and theyare moving from hourly to 30-minute aggregation windows. They also introduced tiered pricing where accelerator usage has a separate per-minute surcharge. 

Noah - Billing: Important: we need a clear canonicalization plan. Persist raw_currency + raw_amount_minor, store fx_rate_at_ingest, and convert only at invoice creation. For tiered surcharge, we should keep separate invoice lines (base vs accel surcharge).

Kai (Eng): On ingestion we'll add: partner_currency, partner_amount_minor, fx_rate_at_ingest, aggregation_window_start_utc, sku_component. Also source_granularity set to "30m". For dedupe: aggregation_id if provided; else (partner_id, aggregation_window_start_utc, sku_signature).

Yuna (HW Partner): We'll include aggregation_id in rollups and a component tag: component=base|accel. We can also include a legacy_hourly flag for two weeks to ease transition.

Elena (Partner Ops): Entitlements: continue mapping by UTC_day and sku_signature. If a customer's reserved capacity is on hourly boundaries, we should offer a temporary grace window so they don't lose reserved slots during the cutover.

Noah - Billing: Rounding policy: sum partner_amount_minor across 30m windows into invoice line totals, then apply "round half away from zero" when converting JPY->USD at invoice time. For very small surcharges (<¥1) accumulate until the invoice period to avoid noise.

Kai (Eng): We'll add a feature flag prefer_30m_rollup_for_billing and a fallback prefer_hourly_for_legacy. PR target: tomorrow EOD. Also add audit fields original_event_count and aggregation_id for traceability.

Samira (Partnerships): Yuna, can FluxCompute provide a 14-day sandbox with old hourly vs new 30m files plus a sample of accelerator-tagged rows? Also a mapping CSV old_sku -> sku_component?

Yuna (HW Partner): Yes, we'll provide sandbox files and mapping CSV by Friday. We'll also include notes on their rounding rule (they send amounts in JPY minor units).

Elena (Partner Ops): Action items: Kai -> schema PR + flags, Noah -> billing playbook update and sample JPY->USD journal entries, Yuna -> sandbox + mapping CSV, Samira -> partner comms and grace window proposal. Sync Friday 11am PT.

ingest-bot: Alert: scheduled schema-change-watch for FluxCompute on 2026-09-10T00:00:00Z. Monitor duplicate_rate and currency_mismatch for 72h.

Noah - Billing: One more: define reconciliation window 5 days for backfills. After 5 days, adjustments generate credit memos and require Partner Ops approval.

Samira (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. We'll aim to minimize bill surprises and keep customers covered during the transition.
